mechanism: Both drugs inhibit CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, leading to increased clarithromycin levels and potential QT prolongation; fluconazole also inhibits clarithromycin metabolism.
action: Monitor ECG for QT prolongation; consider alternative antifungal or macrolide; if unavoidable, reduce clarithromycin dose and monitor for adverse effects including arrhythmias.
